prompt: Bug report from a user: "Track files exported from my Garmin app fail with `trailhead: line 1: expected the header 'lat,lon,ele'`, but when I open one in my editor the first line is exactly `lat,lon,ele`. One of the files is attached as `garmin-export.csv`." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files; head -c 64 garmin-export.csv | xxd; grep -rn "expected the header" . --include=* -r --exclude-dir=.git | head
cat src/trailhead/track.py; grep -rn "open(\|read_text\|encoding" src tests; cat tests/test_track.py | head -60

python - <<'EOF'

    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):''','''    header_seen = False
    # Some exporters (Garmin, Excel) prefix the file with a UTF-8 byte order mark.
    text = text.removeprefix("\\ufeff")
    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):''')
p.write_text(s)
t=pathlib.Path("tests/test_track.py")

s=s.replace('''def test_bad_header():''','''def test_byte_order_mark_is_ignored(tmp_path):

    assert len(load_track(path).points) == 2
    assert len(parse_track("\\ufeff# name: Bom\\nlat,lon,ele\\n0,0,0\\n0,1,0\\n").points) == 2


def test_bad_header():''')
